projects.title: persona ai
projects.description: AI tool for researchers' meeting recording and analysis.

data.title: TECH STACK
data.body: AWS Lambda, RDS Database, Serverless Architecture

data.title: Problem
data.body: Persona AI needed a smart, automated solution to help researchers efficiently analyze interview recordings by extracting relevant content based on targeted keywords—eliminating the need for time-consuming manual reviews.

data.title: Challenges
data.body: Devflovv faced the challenge of building a scalable, serverless backend capable of handling real-time data processing, video analysis, and clip generation, while also preparing the system for secure and future-proof user authentication.

data.title: Solution
data.body: Devflovv developed PersonaAI on serverless architecture, enabling high performance and availability with low operational overhead. RDS Aurora was used as a database layer and AWS ElastiCache(Redis) for server-side caching. Through VAPI APIs, the platform conducts AI-moderated interviews for the researchers created by the research creator. Additionally, Implemented AWS Cognito for the authentication layer. The platform is a powerful web-based AI tool that empowers researchers to extract actionable insights faster and more effectively.

data.title: Problem
data.body: Students often juggle multiple tools for writing, editing, referencing, and detecting AI-generated or plagiarized content—causing friction, wasted time, and inconsistent results. LearnEZ aimed to centralize these academic tasks in one intuitive, AI-powered platform.

data.title: Challenges
data.body: A major hurdle emerged with social media in-app browsers (like TikTok and Instagram), which blocked Google SSO, disrupting the user login experience. Additionally, designing eight feature-rich tools under one clean UI while managing seamless user access through subscriptions required careful planning and execution.

data.title: Solution
data.body: Devflovv delivered an all-in-one academic productivity suite with a smooth, subscription-based model and free trial access. A smart browser detection and redirect system ensured reliable authentication, even from restricted environments. Each tool—ranging from grammar and plagiarism checks to AI content analysis—was crafted for maximum value and ease of use, enabling students to boost productivity in one place.

projects.title: THE BUILDCLUB
projects.description: A Chrome extension for price comparison across multiple home improvement retailers

data.title: TECH STACK
data.body: React, AWS Amplify, Stripe, JavaScript

data.title: Problem
data.body: BuildClub required a Chrome extension that could compare real-time product prices across Home Depot, Lowe’s, Amazon, and Ace Hardware. It needed to display best deals, integrate affiliate links, and remain user-friendly for shoppers.

data.title: Challenges
data.body: Amazon’s API restrictions made it difficult to perform multiple product searches efficiently. Price accuracy was complicated by varying location-based rates. Integrating affiliate links without cluttering the interface demanded careful UI/UX planning and performance tuning.

data.title: Solution
data.body: Devflovv developed a React-based Chrome extension using AWS Amplify and Stripe. It dynamically fetches prices, flags the best deals, and supports a Stripe-powered subscription model. The extension is scalable for future updates like barcode scanning and retailer expansion.
